footnotes:
Parts marked NOT SOLD SEP. are serviced as part of the complete valve section, the relief or check cartridge, the seal kit, or the spool positioner kit listed below.
Also listed, not shown on diagram:
- C42651 Control Valve Section - Actuate (Bucket), Swing, and Stabilizer Circuits, consisting of above listed parts. NOTE - Two Orifice Plates C42657 must be added to complete Swing Section. Also, one heavy duty seal plate retainer kit C42885 (not shown) must be added and bolted over seal plate retainer (19) to complete bucket or swing sections (not required on stabilizer section)
- C42663 Control Valve Section Seal Kit - Actuate (Bucket), Swing, and Stabilizer Circuits, consisting of: 22 (qty 2), 9 (qty 2), 10 (qty 2), 11 (qty 4), 12 (qty 2), 15 (qty 2), pressure section seal (qty 2), and exhaust section seal (qty 2)
